setup: CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, region TEXT, product TEXT, amount INTEGER); INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1, 'east', 'a', 10), (2, 'east', 'b', 20), (3, 'west', 'a', 30), (4, NULL, 'b', 40)

cases.name: rollup_with_grouping
cases.sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total, GROUPING(region) AS g FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region) ORDER BY g, region NULLS FIRST

cases.name: cube_with_grouping_id
cases.sql: SELECT region, product, SUM(amount) AS total, GROUPING(region, product) AS gid FROM sales GROUP BY CUBE(region, product) ORDER BY gid, region NULLS FIRST, product NULLS FIRST

cases.name: grouping_sets_with_empty_set
cases.sql: SELECT region, product, COUNT(*) AS c, GROUPING(region, product) AS gid FROM sales GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region), (product), ()) ORDER BY gid, region NULLS FIRST, product NULLS FIRST

cases.name: plain_group_by_cross_product_with_rollup
cases.sql: SELECT region, product, SUM(amount) AS total FROM sales GROUP BY region, ROLLUP(product) ORDER BY region NULLS FIRST, GROUPING(product), product NULLS FIRST

cases.name: having_keeps_only_grand_total
cases.sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region) HAVING GROUPING(region) = 1

cases.name: grouping_id_alias_matches_grouping
cases.sql: SELECT region, product, GROUPING_ID(region, product) AS gid FROM sales GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region, product)) ORDER BY region NULLS FIRST, product NULLS FIRST
